chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: How Arnett Cobb's injury and Dexter's exit kept him with Hamp
summary: After a wrestling mishap, McRae filled in; Dexter gave notice and Hamp begged him to stay rather than join Les Brown.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: All right. Now who did you replace in Hamp's band?
Dexter was there when I went there to join the band.
See, what happened was that -- see Arnie Cobbs and Dexter --
Like I told you before, Arnie Cobbs and Dexter was just playing around -- fooling around. And Dexter stumbled and knocked his shoulder -- Cobbs knocked his shoulder out by being so heavy.
And he wanted to take a couple of weeks off. And the meanwhile, Dexter wouldn't play the 'Flying Home.' (inaudible).

He wouldn't play any of the hard things -- work with Hamp with the vibes. You know, Hamp used to roll the vibes down on the floor and the small band would go to work and had to go out there and do all these things with him.
Anyway, Dexter didn't wanna do that, so
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
say, "Well, when whatchacallum come back" -- Dexter put his notice in. He told me, he say, "Now when Hamp -- when Arnie Cobbs come back, I'm leaving and you can take my chair."
I say, "Oh, no. You can't do that, because I'm going -- (inaudible) be here two weeks. I'm just here to finish out this engagement with Hamp."
"I'm going back to New York. Joe wants me to go to California to join Les Brown."

So in the meanwhile, I told Hamp I -- I say, "Look, I understand that Dexter is gonna leave because he told me" -- "Yeah, well Dexter's gonna leave. (inaudible) come, stay with me now because I need you."
I say, "No. Joe wants me to -- Joe Glaser wants me to come back and go out to the coast and join Les Brown."
Because I had sent Les Brown this arrangement called "Stomp Off." It was a big (inaudible), you know. And it got lost in the mail. We (inaudible).
So I didn't bother about (inaudible). I got another copy now, but I didn't bother about doing anything with it.
So, I stayed with Hamp quite a while, almost three years. We travelled a lot.
